gloss: extreme heat; severe heat; scorching weather

definitions.gloss: extreme heat; severe heat; scorching summer weather
definitions.explanation: extremely hot weather conditions, more severe than ordinary summer heat; often used when temperatures significantly exceed normal levels

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{例年|れいねん}→例年：11561_reinen⟧にない{酷暑|こくしょ}だ。
examples.english: This year is experiencing unprecedented extreme heat.

examples.japanese: {酷暑|こくしょ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{農作物|のうさくもつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: The extreme heat has damaged crops.

examples.japanese: {酷暑|こくしょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧、⟦エアコン→エアコン：05282_eakon⟧なし⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{過|す}ごせない→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧。
examples.english: In this extreme heat, I can't survive without air conditioning.

notes:
FORMS:
{酷|こく} (severe, cruel) + {暑|しょ} (heat) → severe heat

INTENSITY SCALE (from less to more severe):
- ⟦{暑|あつ}さ→暑さ：12973_atsusa⟧ (heat - general)
- ⟦{猛暑|もうしょ}→猛暑：08311_mousho⟧ (intense heat - 35°C+)
- {酷暑|こくしょ} (extreme/severe heat)
- ⟦{炎暑|えんしょ}→炎暑：19813_ensho⟧ (scorching heat - literary)

USAGE:
{酷暑|こくしょ} is slightly more formal and emphatic than ⟦{猛暑|もうしょ}→猛暑：08311_mousho⟧. It emphasizes the cruel, unbearable nature of the heat.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{猛暑|もうしょ}→猛暑：08311_mousho⟧ (intense heat)
- ⟦{猛暑日|もうしょび}→猛暑日：09622_moushobi⟧ (day over 35°C)
- ⟦{熱中症|ねっちゅうしょう}→熱中症：08330_necchuushou⟧ (heatstroke)
- ⟦{厳冬|げんとう}→厳冬：08556_gentou⟧ (severe winter - opposite season)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {酷暑|こくしょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧ (summer of extreme heat)
- {酷暑|こくしょ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧ (extreme heat continues)
- {酷暑|こくしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{乗|の}り{切|き}る→乗り切る：11410_norikiru⟧ (to get through the extreme heat)
